The '''Facet Test Site''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military facility on the remote planet [[Eredenn Prime]]. It was located near [[Eredenn Station]] and was used, along with the [[Shard Test Site]], to test the secret [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] weapon. The Facet Test Site was [[Battle of Eredenn|attacked]] and destroyed by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="GB:CC" />
